title: —Newman, I think.
html_source:
Stephen isn’t very definite here. He follows his belief with “I think”, perhaps because he hasn’t made up his mind, or that he is being somewhat reticent to avoid judgement or anything of the sort.

John Henry Newman, “Cardinal Newman,” was a Roman Catholic Cardinal (after leaving the Church of England), that Joyce held “a lifelong admiration” for his writing.
